<action>

  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "token=<TOKEN>" \
  -d "types=public_channel,private_channel" | jq '.'
</action>

  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \

  -d "types=public_channel,private_channel" \
  -d "limit=1000" | jq '.channels[] | select(.name == "mentorship-hub") | {id, name}'
</action>

Once I get the channel ID, I'll get its members:

<action>

  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \

  -d "channel=C12345" | jq '.members[]'
</action>

<action>

  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "token=<TOKEN>" \
  -d "query=from:@username" | jq '.messages.matches[]'
</action>

And finally add the 👀 reaction:

<action>

  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "token=<TOKEN>" \

</action>
